name: source1-gameplay
description: Source-1 gameplay entity set for Geppetto Desktop (hammer-triggers-volumes-gameplay-entities): triggers, doors, buttons, movers, breakables, spawns, items/weapons, NPC nodes. Additive to registry/core-source1.json — none of these classes is in core. Every class implicitly accepts the base keyvalues classname (string), targetname (string), parentname (target), angles (angle) and spawnflags (int); they are not repeated per class.

classes.name: trigger_push
classes.description: Brush volume that pushes entities touching it in a direction.

keyvalues.name: pushdir
keyvalues.description: Direction to push (pitch yaw roll).

keyvalues.name: speed
keyvalues.description: Push speed in units per second.

keyvalues.name: filtername
keyvalues.description: Filter entity that decides which entities are pushed.

keyvalues.name: StartDisabled
keyvalues.description: Start disabled. 0 = off, 1 = on.

outputs.name: OnStartTouch
outputs.description: Fired when an entity enters the volume.

outputs.name: OnEndTouch
outputs.description: Fired when an entity leaves the volume.

outputs.name: OnTrigger
outputs.description: Fired when the trigger fires.

classes.name: trigger_teleport
classes.description: Brush volume that teleports entities touching it to a destination.

keyvalues.name: target
keyvalues.description: Teleport destination (info_target or info_teleport_destination).

keyvalues.name: filtername
keyvalues.description: Filter entity that decides which entities are teleported.

keyvalues.name: StartDisabled
keyvalues.description: Start disabled. 0 = off, 1 = on.

outputs.name: OnStartTouch
outputs.description: Fired when an entity enters the volume.

outputs.name: OnTrigger
outputs.description: Fired when the trigger fires.

classes.name: func_door_rotating
classes.description: Rotating door. Rotates around the axis set by spawnflags (default Z).

keyvalues.name: speed
keyvalues.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second.

keyvalues.name: wait
keyvalues.description: Seconds before the door closes again. -1 = stay open.

keyvalues.name: distance
keyvalues.description: Rotation distance in degrees.

keyvalues.name: dmg
keyvalues.description: Damage dealt to entities blocking the door.

keyvalues.name: health
keyvalues.description: Health. 0 = unbreakable; breaking it opens the door.

keyvalues.name: locked
keyvalues.description: Starts locked. 0 = off, 1 = on.

keyvalues.name: noise1
keyvalues.description: Sound played while the door moves.

keyvalues.name: noise2
keyvalues.description: Sound played when the door stops moving.

spawnflags.name: Starts Open
spawnflags.description: The door starts in the open position.

spawnflags.name: Reverse Dir
spawnflags.description: The door rotates in the opposite direction.

outputs.name: OnFullyOpen
outputs.description: Fired when the door finishes opening.

outputs.name: OnFullyClosed
outputs.description: Fired when the door finishes closing.

outputs.name: OnLockedUse
outputs.description: Fired when a locked door is used.

outputs.name: OnOpen
outputs.description: Fired when the door starts opening.

outputs.name: OnClose
outputs.description: Fired when the door starts closing.

classes.name: func_rot_button
classes.description: Brush button that rotates when pressed and fires outputs.

keyvalues.name: speed
keyvalues.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second.

keyvalues.name: distance
keyvalues.description: Rotation distance in degrees.

keyvalues.name: wait
keyvalues.description: Seconds before the button resets. -1 = never reset.

keyvalues.name: health
keyvalues.description: Health. 0 = unbreakable; breaking it presses the button.

outputs.name: OnPressed
outputs.description: Fired when the button is pressed.

outputs.name: OnDamaged
outputs.description: Fired when the button takes damage.

outputs.name: OnIn
outputs.description: Fired when the button reaches its pressed position.

outputs.name: OnOut
outputs.description: Fired when the button returns to its rest position.

classes.name: func_movelinear
classes.description: Brush that slides along a direction between two positions.

keyvalues.name: movedir
keyvalues.description: Direction of travel (pitch yaw roll).

keyvalues.name: movedistance
keyvalues.description: Distance to move in units.

keyvalues.name: speed
keyvalues.description: Movement speed in units per second.

keyvalues.name: startposition
keyvalues.description: Starting position as a fraction 0..1 along the travel.

keyvalues.name: StartDisabled
keyvalues.description: Start disabled. 0 = off, 1 = on.

outputs.name: OnFullyOpen
outputs.description: Fired when the mover reaches the open position.

outputs.name: OnFullyClosed
outputs.description: Fired when the mover reaches the closed position.

classes.name: func_tracktrain
classes.description: Brush train that follows a path_track route. The train itself fires no outputs; path_tracks fire OnPass as it passes them.

keyvalues.name: target
keyvalues.description: First path_track of the route.

keyvalues.name: speed
keyvalues.description: Speed in units per second.

keyvalues.name: startspeed
keyvalues.description: Speed when the train starts.

keyvalues.name: StartDisabled
keyvalues.description: Start disabled. 0 = off, 1 = on.

inputs.name: StartForward
inputs.description: Start moving forward along the route.

inputs.name: StartBackward
inputs.description: Start moving backward along the route.

inputs.name: TeleportToPathNode
inputs.description: Teleport the train to a path_track.

classes.name: func_plat
classes.description: Elevator platform: a brush that moves up and down by its height.

keyvalues.name: height
keyvalues.description: Travel height in units.

keyvalues.name: speed
keyvalues.description: Movement speed in units per second.

classes.name: func_breakable
classes.description: Breakable brush: breaks when its health reaches zero, firing OnBreak.

keyvalues.name: health
keyvalues.description: Health. 0 = unbreakable.

keyvalues.name: material
keyvalues.description: Material type: 0 = glass, 1 = wood, 2 = metal, 3 = flesh, 4 = cinder block, 5 = ceiling tile, 6 = computer, 7 = unbreakable glass, 8 = rock.

keyvalues.name: explodemagnitude
keyvalues.description: Explosion magnitude when broken. 0 = no explosion.

outputs.name: OnBreak
outputs.description: Fired when the brush breaks.

outputs.name: OnHealthChanged
outputs.description: Fired when health changes; passes the new health.

classes.name: func_pushable
classes.description: Pushable brush: a physics brush the player can push around.

keyvalues.name: health
keyvalues.description: Health. 0 = unbreakable.

keyvalues.name: friction
keyvalues.description: Friction against the ground. 0 = default.

outputs.name: OnBreak
outputs.description: Fired when the brush breaks.

outputs.name: OnHealthChanged
outputs.description: Fired when health changes; passes the new health.

classes.name: info_player_teamspawn
classes.description: Team spawn point: a player spawn for one team.

keyvalues.name: TeamNum
keyvalues.description: Team number. 0 = any team.

classes.name: info_node
classes.description: AI navigation node: a point NPCs can path through.

classes.name: info_node_hint
classes.description: AI node hint: tells NPCs how to use a nearby node (cover, sniper spot, guard post).

keyvalues.name: hint
keyvalues.description: Hint type, e.g. Crouch Cover, Guard Position, Sniper, Watch Position (see the FGD HintType list).

keyvalues.name: nodeid
keyvalues.description: Node ID this hint belongs to. 0 = auto-assign at compile.

classes.name: info_target
classes.description: Named target point: an aim or destination marker other entities can point at.

classes.name: info_teleport_destination
classes.description: Teleport destination: where a trigger_teleport sends entities.

classes.name: path_track
classes.description: Path node for a func_tracktrain route. Fires OnPass when a train passes it.

keyvalues.name: target
keyvalues.description: Next path_track on the route.

keyvalues.name: speed
keyvalues.description: Train speed at this track. 0 = keep current speed.

keyvalues.name: orientationtype
keyvalues.description: Train orientation: 0 = no change, 1 = face direction of travel, 2 = face this track's angles.

outputs.name: OnPass
outputs.description: Fired when a train passes this track.

classes.name: item_healthkit
classes.description: Health kit pickup: restores health on touch.

classes.name: item_healthvial
classes.description: Health vial pickup: restores a small amount of health on touch.

classes.name: item_battery
classes.description: Suit battery pickup: recharges suit power on touch.

classes.name: npc_citizen
classes.description: Citizen NPC: a human ally that follows squad orders and takes cover.

keyvalues.name: squadname
keyvalues.description: Squad the NPC belongs to.

keyvalues.name: hintgroup
keyvalues.description: Hint group the NPC is limited to.

keyvalues.name: sleepstate
keyvalues.description: Sleep state: 0 = none, 1 = waiting for threat, 2 = waiting for PVS, 3 = waiting for input.

keyvalues.name: wakeradius
keyvalues.description: Radius in which the NPC wakes. 0 = default.

keyvalues.name: wakesquad
keyvalues.description: Wake the whole squad when woken. 0 = no, 1 = yes.

keyvalues.name: physdamagescale
keyvalues.description: Scale for physics damage taken.
